help.monitor.title: Production Stats
help.monitor.text:
Menu → Production Stats (or /통계) shows how much each machine makes per minute, energy generated and used, and stopped machines.
Turn alerts on in the stall list to hear in chat about machines stopped for over 30 seconds because their output is blocked or they lack energy or fuel. The stall list also moves you next to a machine.
help.tier.title: Machine Upgrades
help.tier.text:
Hold an upgrade kit and right-click a machine to raise it one tier (Basic → Advanced → Precision → Ultimate). Each tier has its own kit, used in order. Speed and energy buffer go up and energy per job goes down; Harvesters, Vacuums and Tree Fellers get a larger range, and Generators a higher output.
Make the first kit from alloy from the Alloy Smelter → Control Circuit → kit; each next kit is made from the one before. Breaking a machine returns the kits used on it.
help.copier.title: Config Copier
help.copier.text:
Copies the settings of a conduit side, a conduit bundle, an Auto Crafter recipe or a Drawer and pastes them elsewhere.
Right-click: copy
Sneak + right-click: paste
Right-click the air: clear
help.magicsieve.title: Magic Sieve
help.magicsieve.text:
An Auto Sieve with an essence slot. Put in a mob's essence and the output switches to that mob's theme: Drowned give ocean items, Piglins Nether items and Endermen End items, and harder mobs give rare items more often.
One essence lasts 24 sifts. See the theme tables in Codex → Mobs.

help.start.title: Getting Started
help.start.text:
§fMine the tree in the middle of the island bare-handed to collect §eLogs§f. Make Log → Oak Planks → §eCrafting Table§f → §dResearch Table§f (2 Crafting Tables), then start by researching §dSticks§f at the Research Table. At first you can only make these three; every other recipe unlocks through research.

§fIf you lose all your saplings, use §e/묘목§f (once every 10 minutes). §eSneaking repeatedly§f next to a sapling makes it grow fast.

§7Open the menu with the menu item in the last hotbar slot, /menu or /sg (if you lose it, /메뉴발급). The quest panel on the right shows what to do next.
help.handwork.title: Handwork Resources
help.handwork.text:
§fHold a Stick and §eright-click Grass or Dirt§f to get §ePebbles§f. 4 Pebbles → Cobblestone ("Stone Packing" research).
§fStrip a §eLog with a right-click§f using a Stone or better Axe to sometimes get §eBark Fiber§f. 4 Fibers (in a square) → 2 Paper ("Paper" research). A Fiber also burns as fuel, as long as a Stick.
§fA Hammer breaks Cobblestone → Gravel → Sand → Dust, and sifting them gives Ore Chunks and more.
help.sieve.title: Sieve and Hammer
help.sieve.text:
§fSieve: right-click while holding Gravel, Sand, Dirt or Dust to load one, then each right-click sifts it, and on the 8th the by-products pop out on top. Sieves in a 3×3 area on the same level sift together.
§fMesh: a Sieve needs a Mesh. Right-click the Sieve holding a Mesh to fit it; sneak and right-click with an empty hand to remove it. String → Flint → Iron → Gold → Diamond → Netherite Meshes give more and rarer items.
§fHammer: mining Stone, Cobblestone, Gravel or Sand with it drops the next finer block.
§fAuto Sieve: runs on energy; insert and extract with Hoppers and Conduits.
help.fairy.title: Fairies and Magic
help.fairy.text:
§fEvery night about midnight a fairy visits someone on the island. Use it within §e1 minute§f and it throws its gift at your feet; leave it and it scatters the gift around you and flies off. The gift always holds 2-3 §eFairy Wing Dust§f.
§fThe research "Fairy Magic" (2 dust, a Research Table) gives a §eFairy Board§f at once. Dust, an emerald and dust in a row on a crafting table make a §eFairy Emerald§f; dust, a Research Table and dust make a Fairy Board. Emeralds come from sifting gravel with an iron or better mesh.
§fHold the board and use it to open the spells; each costs one Fairy Emerald. The weather and the time it has left show there too.
§bRain§f: timed crops and magic plants grow 1.5 times as fast.
§bSnow§f: energy machines work 1.5 times as fast on the same energy.
§fRain and snow last 3 days (an hour); casting the same weather again adds 3 days. Clear ends the effect. The island's weather never changes by itself.
§eSun§f: fix it at day, dusk or night, or let it flow (the default). Only a change costs an emerald, and it stays until changed again. The date, crops and the fairy keep their time while the sun stands still.
§eFairy Time§f research (4 dust, 8 bone meal): §eFairy Bone Meal§f grows crops and magic plants 2 minutes ahead and a sapling into its tree at once; plain bone meal does not work on timed crops. The §eFairy Hourglass§f runs an energy machine twice as fast for 10 minutes (up to an hour).
help.water.title: Dirt, Water and Lava
help.water.text:
§fComposter: right-click in 32 Leaves, Saplings, Seeds, crops or Bark Fiber one at a time; after 30 seconds they become §e1 Dirt§f.
§fBarrel: put in 32 of the same materials and it fills with §bwater§f after 1 minute. Right-click it with an empty Bucket to scoop it out. Right-click a water-filled Barrel with Dust to get a §eClay Ball§f.
§fStone Barrel: each Cobblestone, Stone, Gravel or Netherrack adds 250 mB, and a §6heat source§f below (Torch, Lantern, Campfire, Lava, Fire) slowly melts it into §6lava§f. 1000 mB fills a bucket.
§7A cobblestone generator built from water and lava gives endless stone.
help.fluid.title: Fluids and Lava
help.fluid.text:
A §eFluid Tank§f holds up to 16000 mB of water or lava. Pour and scoop with buckets; §9Fluid Conduits§f pass liquids between neighboring tanks, barrels, crucibles and generators.
An §eElectric Crucible§f uses energy to melt Cobblestone one at a time into 250 mB of lava. Feed it with hoppers or conduits.
A §eLava Generator§f burns lava for 80 RE/t (1 mB every 2 ticks).
§7Cobblestone → Electric Crucible → Fluid Conduit → Lava Generator turns cobblestone into energy.
help.research.title: Research
help.research.text:
§fAt first only Oak Planks, the Crafting Table and the Research Table are unlocked. Use a §dResearch Table§f (2 Crafting Tables) to choose a research.

Press the §aResearch§f button on the left of the research window to use the materials from your inventory all at once (nothing is used if you are short), and the recipe unlocks right away for everyone on the island. Hover over the slots on the right to see names.

§7Furnace smelting and machine processing are never locked.
help.quest.title: Advancements
help.quest.text:
§fMenu → §eAdvancements§f gives hints about what to do next. The quest panel on the right shows the earliest open Advancement, along with the materials when research is needed.
§fEveryone on the island works on Advancements together. When one is completed, the next hint appears in chat.
§7If you get stuck, read the Advancement hints and the research window descriptions first.
help.power.title: Energy and Machines
help.power.text:
§fMost machines run on §eenergy (RE)§f. Fuel such as Coal, Charcoal or Planks in a §eCombustion Generator§f makes energy, which passes to adjacent machines or through §eEnergy Conduits§f. Without energy a machine stops and its materials stay where they are.
§fThere are Crushers, Auto Sieves, Auto Miners, Auto Crop Harvesters, Alloy Smelters, Ore Washers and Mob Simulators. An §eEnergy Cell§f stores spare energy.
§f§eElectric Furnaces§f smelt without fuel. §eAuto Crafters§f craft the recipe picked from the list in their window once the materials are in. §eItem Vacuums§f collect dropped items, and §eTree Fellers§f cut trees and plant saplings.
§fRight-click a machine to open its window. Hoppers and Conduits insert from the top and sides and extract from the bottom. Breaking a machine drops it with its contents. The info icon in the window explains the machine.
§7The panel that appears when you look at a machine shows progress and energy.
help.conduit.title: Conduits
help.conduit.text:
§fMake §cEnergy§f, §bItem§f and §9Fluid§f Conduits from Conduit Binder (a smelted checkerboard mix of Sand and Gravel). One block can hold all three kinds, and conduits connect on their own to neighboring conduits of the same kind, machines and chests.
§fItem Conduits start with every side off. §eRight-click a conduit or joint§f to open the settings window and set extract, insert and the channel (color). Sneak and right-click to place the block in your hand. Items only move between matching channels.
§fConduits get faster from Basic → Enhanced → Ender. Craft a conduit of the tier below with an Electrum Ingot (Enhanced), or a Steel Ingot and a Diamond (Ender).
help.drawer.title: Drawers and Controllers
help.drawer.text:
§fRight-click the front: insert the held item. Twice within 0.5 seconds: insert all matching items from your inventory.
§fLeft-click the front: take 1; sneak + left-click: take 1 stack.
§fRight-click with a Lock Key: lock (keeps the item type when empty). Upgrades: Capacity (×2·×4·×8), Void (overflow disappears).
§fSneak and right-click with an empty hand or an item that is not a block: Drawer window. Mining any side other than the front keeps the contents.
§f§eStorage Controllers§f let connected Drawers (within 16 blocks) work as one storage. Link distant Drawers with a §eStorage Link§f.
§fRight-click a Controller: insert the held item. Twice within 0.5 seconds: insert every kind the storage holds from your inventory.
help.metal.title: Metals and Alloys
help.metal.text:
§fSieves drop Iron, Gold, Copper, Tin, Lead, Silver and Nickel §eOre Chunks§f (more with a better Mesh). 4 Chunks → ore.
§fOre smelts into 1 ingot in a Furnace, breaks into 2 dusts with a §eHammer§f, and gives 3 to 5 raw ore in a §eCrusher§f. Raw ore smelts into 1 ingot in a Furnace or washes into 2 dusts in an §eOre Washer§f (needs water), and dust smelts into ingots.
§f§eAlloy Smelter§f: Bronze (3 Copper + 1 Tin), Electrum (Gold + Silver), Invar (2 Iron + 1 Nickel), Steel (Iron + 4 Coal).
§fAlloys are used for tool heads and faster conduits.
help.dimension.title: Monsters and the Second Dimension
help.dimension.text:
§fNo monsters spawn on the island. Use the §eDimension Teleport Stone§f (research "Second Dimension") to open the second dimension's window.

§e■ Hunts§r
Pick a monster and go in: on a wide plain, after 5 seconds, that monster comes at you, stronger and stronger. Kill them all in time to clear the hunt; falling or running out of time fails it. Either way you keep your items and go back where you came from.

§e■ Stars and unlocks§r
Every monster has three stars (a clear, a clear in the star time, enough kills in all). With all three, a fairy emerald opens the next monster.

§e■ Gear§r
You leave your inventory behind and go in with your §ehunting kit§r only (4 armor slots, a weapon in hand, 3 relic slots). An item put in a slot leaves your inventory and comes back when you clear the slot. Hunts do not wear it, and you get your inventory back when you return. While hunting you only move: your weapon swings ahead of you on its own and your relics fight by themselves. Use the menu item to give up. Raise relics' grade at the relic table. Experience gems from the monsters level you up; pick an upgrade at each level.

§e■ Essences§r
Monster essences come only from the second dimension. Register a cleared monster in a dimension essence collector to keep receiving its essences by its best time. Essences feed the mob simulator, the magic sieve, magic flower seeds and relics.
help.gear.title: Gear
help.gear.text:
§fAt the §eTinker Table§f pick a metal head and a handle to make a Pickaxe, Axe or Shovel. Tools gain experience as you use them and level up; each level adds an upgrade slot where you apply upgrades with materials (Haste, Reinforced). Tools do not fight: the second dimension's §erelics§f do.
§fEach metal also has armor. Unlock its recipes through research and wear it.
help.magic.title: Magic Plants
help.magic.text:
§fAfter the "Magic Seeds" research, craft §eflower seeds§f (one per color): wheat seeds in the middle, a dye of the color on each side, three essences of one monster above and three fairy dust below. Plant them on Dirt or Grass; once in full bloom, right-click to harvest §epetals§f, and the plant grows back.
§fThe "Magic Plants" research unlocks Ore Bloom seeds and "Gem Bloom" Gem Bloom seeds. Ore Blooms grow Ore Chunks and Gem Blooms grow gems.
§fAfter the "Dyeing" research, petals become dyes.
help.island.title: Island Expansion
help.island.text:
§fMenu → Island → Island Expansion: switches to a top-down view. Tap a chunk on the screen to pick it and buy it (Cobblestone) or leave from the panel on the right (with the JSON UI menus, pick with the movement keys and sneak for the menu).

§aGreen§f: owned, §eYellow§f: for sale (next to an owned chunk).
§7You can only build and mine inside owned chunks. Items that fall into the void go to Lost and Found.

machine.furnace.help.2: §7Needs energy and is twice as fast as a Furnace.

machine.vacuum.help.2: §7Gathers items within 6 blocks sideways, 3 below and 5 above into its output slots.

machine.feller.help.2: §7With no logs to cut, it plants saplings from its input slot.
machine.feller.help.3: §7With nowhere to plant either, it uses bone meal on nearby saplings.

machine.crafter.help.1: §7Crafts the set recipe whenever the materials are in.
machine.crafter.help.2: §7Pick the recipe to make from the list in its window.
machine.crafter.help.3: §7Materials go in the 3×3 slots on the left; results stack in the slots on the right.

help.goal.title: Goal and Progression
help.goal.text:
§fThe final goal of this island is to place a §6Dragon Egg§f on it and §ecomplete Sky Gear§f.

§eProgression§f
1. Handwork: Pebbles, String, Hammers and Sieves until you get iron
2. Energy: run machines with Generators and Conduits for your first automation, and make Research Essence at the Essence Extractor
3. Metals: grow the factory with alloys, fluids and the Mob Simulator
4. Combat: Dimension Gate waves and gear
5. Magic: grow ores, gems and essence from flowers
6. Projects: finish the Factory, Hunter and Grower projects to get the Dragon Egg

§7The research window and the Advancement hints guide you step by step. See §f/도감§7 for where items come from and what they are used for, and Menu → Help when you get stuck.
help.lines.title: Automation Line Examples
help.lines.text:
§eCobblestone line§f
Auto Miner (on Cobblestone) → Item Conduit → Crusher → Hopper → Auto Sieve → Chest

§eWood line§f
Tree Feller + Item Vacuum: logs and saplings collect in the Vacuum, and saplings go back to the Feller through a conduit.

§eMetal line§f
Sieve → Crusher (3–5 raw ores) → Ore Washer (2 dusts) → Electric Furnace → Alloy Smelter → Drawer

§eEssence line§f
Drawer (materials) → Item Conduit → Essence Extractor → Drawer. Use one Essence Extractor per kind of essence.

§eGood to know§f
- A machine outputs from its bottom face; the other faces are inputs.
- Energy Conduits link Generators to machines, and Energy Cells store spare energy.
- If a machine stops, look at it. It shows Stopped with no energy, output slots full or missing materials.
